verified.method: Verified on rendered images (viewed by the builder): the pages of the company screenshots PDF rendered by tool_shots.py – the 220-DPI zoomed crop of the column-header strip + the whole financing section and the 150-DPI full page(s) with the highlight boxes – and the other pages of the consolidated statement (operating / investing / appendices, 120 DPI). Compared with the final data: every line text, every value digit by digit (3 columns x 8 lines + total; c1 header '2026' under the shared 3-month heading), the column headers (periods, audit status), the units/currency, the item mapping, and the (*) lines outside financing. Operating/investing p. 57 hold no interest/dividend-paid line ('ריבית שהתקבלה' only). C1 = 0 in every column. The text layer was used only to locate pages and to read supporting pages (balance sheet / notes / equity statement) for the mapping decisions.
